paite: Asuangphum tang siangthou ah a-om hi.
heading: Korah tapate phatna La / Jerusalem Phatna
english: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

paite: TOUPA'N Zion kulh kongkhakte Jakob omna tengteng sang in a-itzaw ahi.
english: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

paite: Pathian khopi aw, na tungthu thupitak in agen uhi. Selah
english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

paite: Hon theite lak ah apang sam uh chih Rahab leh Babulon tungtang thu ka gen ding; Philistia leh Tura, Ethiopia toh, "En un, hiai mi huai lai a piang ahi," achi ua.
english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

paite: Zion tungtang thu gen ahih chiang in, "Hiai mi leh huai mi amah a piang ahi; Tungnungpen ngei in amah ahihkip ding," chi a gen ahi dia;
english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

paite: TOUPA'N, mite' min gelh a akhumlut chiang in, "Hiai mi huai a piang ahi," achi ding a, Selah
english: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

paite: Lasate leh lamte'n, "Ka tuikhuk teng nangmah ah ahi a-om," achi ding uhi.
english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
